kg_child_context_reason: The generated fragments instantiate and wire all listed child modules, and final merge correctness depends on exact child port names, widths, reset/clock wiring, handshake connections, and Wishbone DMA mux ownership.
code_gap_notes: The module frame still lacks the complete top-level port list, so Wishbone, SDC, optional interrupt, and clock port names and widths must be reconstructed from the interface specs.

Generated fragments use non-spec top-level names such as cmd_dat_i, cmd_oe_o, cmd_out_o, DAT_dat_i, DAT_oe_o, and DAT_dat_o, which must be reconciled with sd_cmd_dat_i, sd_cmd_oe_o, sd_cmd_out_o, sd_dat_dat_i, sd_dat_oe_o, and sd_dat_out_o.

Clock/reset merge is ambiguous: cmd_serial_rst is assigned but not declared in the declarations fragment and the sd_cmd_serial_host instance currently uses core_rst instead of the reset that includes cmd_go_idle.

Master Wishbone widths need validation because the top interface block and child filler interfaces disagree on m_wb_sel_o, m_wb_cti_o, and m_wb_bte_o widths while the mux fragment drives 4-bit select, 3-bit CTI, and 2-bit BTE.
Register/status assembly has width-extension concerns for Bd_Status_reg fields because free_tx_bd and free_rx_bd are BD_WIDTH-wide but assigned into 8-bit slices.
Optional compile-time ports and interrupt outputs require conditional handling consistent with SDC_CLK_SEP and SDC_IRQ_ENABLE.

S008 is required for reset composition, byte select behavior, and implementation details for the TX/RX Wishbone mux.
S009 is required for compile-time clock source selection and sd_clk_o/sd_clk_o_pad wiring.
